name: backlight-tenderness-home-portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical domestic portrait of an approved adult woman in a lived-in modern kitchen, preserving direct eye contact, raised hair-adjusting pose, wine-red embroidered fashion styling, jewelry, and daylight.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with deep black-brown hair, full airy bangs, natural facial proportions, dewy makeup, soft peach blush, defined lashes, natural brows, and glossy coral-rose lips. She wears a deep wine-red embroidered lace-inspired fashion set with opaque secure coverage and delicate gold-toned floral jewelry.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level to slightly high close frontal portrait, mid-thigh-up, standing near a kitchen counter with both arms lifted and hands near the ears as if adjusting hair. Include stainless-steel range hood, utensils, sink, dish rack, shelves with bottles, plants, and flowers. Vertical 2:3.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Directional daylight from camera-left windows with soft room shade and metallic bounce from kitchen surfaces, gentle highlights on face and collarbones, moderate depth of field, realistic smartphone social-media look.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone portrait, vertical 2:3, close frontal angle, natural background softness, realistic skin texture, restrained beauty finish, no mirror or visible phone.
